lines.text: A landowner went out early in the morning to hire workers and agreed to pay them a denarius for the day.
About the third hour the landowner saw others standing in the city gate and sent them into his vineyard.
About the eleventh hour he hired still others, and at evening he had the last hired paid first.
The original workers each received a denarius, grumbled, and said the last hired worked only three hours.
The landowner reminded one grumbler they had agreed on one denarius, and said the last will be first.
